purpose: Registry for the immutable full normalized numerical input artifact used by controlled Market Hunter V2 validation experiments.

artifact.protection: Vercel Authentication; use authorized Vercel access/CLI to retrieve. Do not rely on temporary share URLs as artifact identity.

verification.rationale: The capture build script throws on any contract failure, snapshot verification failure, network-dependent replay, or substantive mismatch. The deployment reached READY.

identityPolicy.canonicalIdentity: Each batch snapshot carries snapshotId, file integrity sha256, full numerical dataSha256, structural structureSha256, exact symbol membership/order, source metadata and normalizationVersion.
identityPolicy.numericalHashIncludes: Adjusted calculation inputs plus all normalized rows/events actually consumed by the backtest.
identityPolicy.structuralHashRole: Secondary diagnostic only; it is not sufficient for numerical experiment identity.
identityPolicy.comparisonRule: Baseline and candidate must consume the same exact local snapshot files. No Yahoo refetch is permitted during a controlled comparison.
